environment.host_agent: Claude Code (desktop), coordinator model claude-fable-5-1; specialists inherit unless stated in their trace header

inputs.paper_package: paper/ (SHA256SUMS inside; 251 verification files, byte-identical to the author's release)
inputs.paper2agent: https://github.com/jmiao24/Paper2Agent (skill read at build time; pipeline mirrored, not executed)

agent_runs.role: coordinator (main Claude Code session; also quotient-geometer role)

policy: paper/ is read-only; every finding carries an evidence tag from results/skeptic_verdict.md; a matching hash is evidence of byte identity, not of mathematical truth (same wording as the paper's SHA256SUMS policy)
